title: Changelog & Bin Feature
message: We added a brand new **Recycle Bin** for restoring deleted notes, instant restore confirmations, and smooth **Themes**! Connect with us on [our Reddit](https://www.reddit.com/r/DigitalStickyNotes/) to share your thoughts.

title: Home Screen Widgets Guide
message: Did you know you can pin sticky notes to your phone screen? Tap the **Widget Pool icon** on any note to add it, then place the widget on your home screen. Learn more in the [Full User Guide](app://guide)!
